classification: defensive malformed-input hardening (no live incident observed): containers are app-written cache files, but an interrupted write, a partial sync or an older build leaves bytes the completeness gate was designed to reject; the two narrowing conversions crash before the gate can reject.

fix.summary: Two guards on untrusted container bytes. (1) Meta.planeBytes multiplies width*height*2 in UInt64 and yields 0 when the product exceeds UInt32, instead of trapping on absurd header dimensions. (2) DZCFile.layout validates each index offset fits Int before converting, instead of trapping on an entry >= 2^63.
